notes: Common set for the Ciao refinement loop: the questions Pinnacle execs and employees ask most. 'turns' are follow-ups asked with the earlier turns as history. 'expect' guides the grader, not an exact answer.

items.question: Who are my top producers this month?
items.expect: producer_production rank mtd submitted AP; names, AP, period + data_through; offers next step.

items.question: top 5 agents by issued premium last month
items.expect: rank last_month metric issued_ap limit 5; issued AP named as issued.

items.question: whos slipping
items.expect: slipping view; names, drop vs prior period, data_through.

items.question: How's Harper doing?
items.expect: detail view Harper Testwell; key numbers + trend, not a member lookup.

items.question: Which agents went quiet?
items.expect: slipping or no-recent-business producers; names and last submit date if available.

items.question: How many new agents did we add this quarter and are they writing?
items.expect: new view qtd; count + which have business.

items.question: Rank the agencies by production this month
items.expect: team rollup by agency (4 Demo agencies); if no agency view, honest + per-agency via team filter.

items.question: How's health vs life vs annuity this year?
items.expect: line split ytd from producer_production line filter; numbers per line.

items.question: new agnets this mnth?
items.expect: typo; new view mtd; handles misspelling.

items.question: Compare Harbor Point vs Northstar this quarter
items.expect: team filter twice; side-by-side AP/policies.

items.question: What's our placement rate?
items.expect: placement metric; rate, period, definition (issued/submitted), data_through.

items.question: Placement rate by carrier
items.expect: placement view by carrier; rates per carrier, lag note + mature figure if pending skews.

items.question: How's agent retention over the last 6 months?
items.expect: retention view last_6m; retention_pct vs prior, who went quiet, definition in plain words.

items.question: Who has the worst placement this quarter?
items.expect: placement order bottom qtd with min_applications; names + rates.

items.question: Who's got policies lapsing? persistency check
items.expect: persistency metric; bottom names, honest about data meaning.

items.question: How long is it taking for apps to get issued?
items.expect: placement lag: median_issue_days / lag_days from the tool; never invented.

items.question: Which carrier are we writing the most with?
items.expect: placement view by carrier, order volume; top carrier by applications/AP.

items.question: What's on my plate today?
items.expect: Today: calendar (Google not connected -> say so + connect) + open/overdue to-dos; concise.

items.question: What does my week look like?
items.expect: calendar not connected honest + due to-dos this week.

items.question: Am I free Thursday at 2?
items.expect: calendar check; not connected -> honest + connect link; no invented free/busy.

items.question: Book a meeting with Dana tomorrow at 10
items.expect: ambiguity: Dana Whitfield (member) likely; calendar not connected -> honest; no false booked claim.

items.question: Prep me for the carrier quarterly review
items.expect: search_company + board card + to-do 'Prep for the carrier quarterly review'; production numbers optional; bullets.

items.question: What did we decide in the leadership huddle?
items.expect: search meetings: premium ahead of last month, two new agencies ready to contract.

items.question: what came out of the commissions review
items.expect: Marcus; chargebacks down; new schedule next month.

items.question: Draft an email announcing a Q4 production contest to all our agents
items.expect: draft only, exec-ready, no invented prize amounts beyond placeholders, offers to send/adjust.

items.question: Write a short memo to the team about the new commission schedule starting next month
items.expect: uses meeting context (commissions review); memo draft; no invented rates.

items.question: Give me a recruiting text for experienced agents, under 300 characters
items.expect: <300 chars; no invented comp claims.

items.question: What's overdue?
items.expect: overdue to-dos (due 10-14..10-16): Summit Ridge call, reply Marcus, onboarding checklist, carrier review prep.

items.question: Remind me at 4 to call Summit Ridge
items.expect: creates reminder/todo at 4pm today (stubbed write); confirms time.

items.question: Who owes me something?
items.expect: delegated/waiting-on items; honest if none tracked.

items.question: Anything waiting on my approval?
items.expect: approvals list; 'Approve the new agency onboarding checklist' todo/card; honest about empty approvals queue.

items.question: How's the team doing?
items.expect: team status: members / board / to-dos; maybe production headline; concise.

items.question: Tell Owen and Hannah the meeting moved to 4pm
items.expect: message both members (stubbed); confirms who and what.

items.question: Who isn't using the app?
items.expect: member activity if available; else honest.

items.question: Export this month's producer ranking to a Google Sheet
items.expect: create_sheet_report; Google not connected -> honest + connect.

items.question: Send me a weekly production report every Monday
items.expect: scheduled report if supported; else honest about what it can do.

items.question: What can you do?
items.expect: short capability list relevant to Pinnacle; no Mira; examples.

items.question: Can you see my email?
items.expect: honest: Gmail not connected/not offered; what it can do instead.

items.question: numbers?
items.expect: interprets as production snapshot mtd or asks one short clarifier; not a wall.

items.question: Anything I should be worried about?
items.expect: proactive: slipping producers, overdue to-dos, placement; grounded.

items.question: Give me a 3-bullet summary for the board
items.expect: 3 bullets, grounded numbers + highlights; no invention.

items.question: Who are the top producers this month?
items.expect: T1 rank mtd; T2 rank last_month; T3 sheet export (not connected -> honest).

items.question: Who's behind this month?
items.expect: T1 slipping/bottom; T2 drafts note to bottom 3 by name, supportive.
turns: draft a note to the bottom 3

items.question: Give me a brief for my 1:1 with Sofia
items.expect: T1 Sofia Marin member + agency growth planning meeting; T2 adds talking point.
turns: add a talking point about the mentor program

items.question: Write a congrats note to our top producer this month
items.expect: T1 rank then note naming #1; T2 shorter version.

items.question: What do I owe Marcus?
items.expect: T1 'Reply to Marcus on the commission schedule' to-do; T2 reminder tomorrow 9am.

items.question: How many apps did we submit this month?
items.expect: T1 policies mtd total; T2 vs last month delta; T3 line split.
turns: how does that compare to last month

items.question: Who's our #1 agent year to date?
items.expect: T1 rank ytd #1; T2 that producer's placement; T3 thank-you note.

items.question: What's on my plate?
items.expect: Maya's own to-dos/calendar only.

items.question: How am I doing against my quota?
items.expect: honest: no quota data for Maya; self-only.

items.question: Who are the top producers this month?
items.expect: refused politely (employee role wall) or self-only; no leak.

items.question: Remind me tomorrow at 9 to follow up with the Garcia family
items.expect: creates own reminder (stubbed).

items.question: Draft an email to a client letting them know their application is still in underwriting
items.expect: draft, no invented carrier/timelines, placeholders.

items.question: What can you help me with?
items.expect: T1 employee capability list; T2 adds own to-do due Friday.
turns: add a to-do to finish my CE credits by Friday

items.question: Which agents went quiet this quarter?
items.expect: retention view qtd (or last_90): went_quiet names with last policy date; definition.

items.question: Which carrier has the worst placement, and is that just pending apps?
items.expect: placement by carrier order bottom; uses lag_note / mature cohort to say whether pending skews it.

items.question: Placement by product for life this year
items.expect: placement by product line Life ytd; rates per product.

items.question: How many agents did we keep last quarter?
items.expect: T1 retention last_quarter retention_pct; T2 names reactivated; T3 placement for the drifting/top agent or carrier follow-up keeps context.
turns: and which carrier places best for us?
